description.narrative: The partnership ?Dialogue and Democracy Across the Atlantic? will take off with a pilot project aiming at empowering the young people of Argentina. We will facilitate a survey and subsequent summit to identify and tackle selected issues in society for young citizens. The input to the observatory will define the themes at the summit, and the intended output will be some policy papers that can be presented to politicians, e.g. ensuring gender equality. We will facilitate workshops and invite key stakeholders and speakers to inspire participants. OAJNU will call for participants across the country between the ages of 18 and 25 . The selection criteria is Argentinians between the ages of 18 and 25 with regard to gender equality and diversity. The pilot project of this transatlantic partnership will be a Youth Empowerment Summit held in Mendoza, Argentina on November 5th and 6th 2022.
